title: Senior Interior Sales Executive
description:
Lifeasy Interior is looking for an experienced, target-driven
**Sales Manager**
who can convert customer enquiries into confirmed projects and contribute to showroom growth.

If you have a strong sales track record, excellent client-handling skills, and the ability to close deals, we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

* Handle showroom walk-ins, incoming enquiries, and prospective customers.
* Understand customer requirements, budgets, design preferences, and project timelines.
* Present suitable interior design and execution solutions.
* Coordinate with the Design Team for consultations, proposals, and quotations.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers and handle sales objections.
* Negotiate commercial terms and convert leads into confirmed projects.
* Maintain lead pipelines, sales reports, and follow-up trackers.
* Build strong customer relationships and achieve monthly sales targets.

Requirements

* Minimum
  **3.5 years of sales experience**
  .

* Strong communication, negotiation, client-handling, and closing skills.
* Proficiency in
  **Google Sheets/Spreadsheets and Microsoft Excel**

* Self-motivated, organised, and comfortable working with performance-based targets.

Job Details

* **Position:**
  Sales Manager – Interior Design
* **Company:**
  Lifeasy Interior
* **Location:**
  Lifeasy Interior Showroom, Palwal, Haryana
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-Time
* **Work Mode:**
  On-Site

title: Technical Sales Executive - Spray Equipments
description:
**Company Description**
Goodie International Pvt. Ltd. is a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-performance chemical solutions for polyurethanes, rubbers, and composites, supported by advanced spray equipment for application. With over 35 years of expertise, the company focuses on innovation, quality, and sustainability to deliver formulations that improve manufacturing efficiency, product quality, and cost-effectiveness. Goodie serves diverse industries and works closely with customers to develop customized solutions for demanding production challenges. Backed by strong technical support and deep industry knowledge, Goodie is recognized as a trusted partner in the market. The company is also the exclusive Indian partner for several global leaders, including Acmos Chemie, Cellular Technology, ISL Chemie, and Schuetze for specialized chemicals and spray equipment.

**Role Description**
The Technical Sales Executive – Spray Equipments is a full-time, on-site role based in Manesar. This role involves managing the sales cycle for spray equipment, including lead generation, product demonstrations, technical presentations, and closing sales with industrial customers. The Technical Sales Executive will respond to customer inquiries, provide technical guidance on equipment selection and application, and coordinate with the engineering and service teams to ensure smooth installation and after-sales support. Daily responsibilities include visiting client sites, preparing quotations, maintaining sales reports, monitoring market trends, and supporting marketing activities such as trade shows and customer trainings. The role requires building long-term relationships with clients, expanding the customer base, and meeting sales targets for spray equipment solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong technical understanding of industrial spray equipment, spray or coating industry process and applications and related manufacturing applications.
* Proven sales and business development skills, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing deals in B2B industrial markets.
* Ability to conduct product demos, technical presentations, and application trials at customer sites.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with engineers, production teams, and purchasing departments.
* Comfort with field work, frequent customer visits, and on-site equipment evaluations.
* Analytical skills to understand customer processes, propose suitable solutions, and prepare accurate quotations.
* Good organizational and time management abilities to handle multiple accounts and projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency with basic office software (e.g., email, spreadsheets, presentations) for reporting and sales documentation.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field is highly preferred.
* Prior experience in technical sales for spray systems, or industrial machinery will be an advantage.

title: Business Development Executive
company: voestalpine VAE VKN India Private Limited
description:
**Company Description**

voestalpine VAE VKN India Private Limited is part of the voestalpine Railway Systems Group, the global market leader in railway infrastructure system solutions. The company delivers innovative drive and locking systems, monitoring equipment for rolling stock and fixed assets, and a wide range of related services. Its solutions support high-speed, heavy haul, and urban traffic applications across international markets. With numerous well-known references worldwide, voestalpine VAE VKN India offers professionals the opportunity to contribute to complex, large-scale railway projects. Team members join a technology-driven environment focused on reliability, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Business Development Executive role based in Sonipat. The role involves identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, building and maintaining a strong sales pipeline, and supporting revenue growth in railway infrastructure solutions. Daily responsibilities include researching potential customers, qualifying leads, conducting meetings and presentations, and preparing proposals in coordination with technical and commercial teams. The Business Development Executive will manage key accounts, nurture long-term client relationships, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. The role also includes regular market analysis, competitor tracking, and collaboration with internal stakeholders to align business development activities with overall company strategy.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong New Business Development and Lead Generation skills, including prospecting, pipeline management, and opportunity qualification.
* Candidates should possess solid Business and Account Management skills to handle client portfolios, negotiate contracts, and drive sustainable growth.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal, to conduct client meetings, deliver presentations, and coordinate with internal teams.
* Relevant experience in industrial, engineering, or infrastructure sectors, preferably in railway or transportation solutions, is highly beneficial.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with comfort using CRM tools and basic MS Office applications.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and travel to customer locations as required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or diploma or equivalent business qualification is an advantage.

* Responsible for acquisition of Gold Loan customers from both NTB walk\-in and ETB customers at branch level.
* Engagement of Gold Loan customers and responsible for cross sell of other products.
* Support the marketing initiatives designed by products \& marketing department for Gold Loan.
* Assess the market potential/trend and give feedback on product modification and new product development to the product teams
* Share insights on competitor products to the product team.
* Responsible for the overall cross sell target assigned to him for other products.

* Oversee follow\-ups with overdue and renewal customers to collect the payments/renewal payment in Gold Loan.
* In absence of CCR, will process all the Service Request and resolve the quires of all customers at branch level.
* In absence of BOO, will act its back\-up for all operational activity.
* Responsible to maintain good coordination with Gold Loan Officer for processing the all leads of Gold Loan with in suggested TAT.
* Should be compatible with Financial Software application Like LOS, Br.net, Finacle etc.
* Ensure smooth operations for Gold Loan and Busimoni at branch at cashier and BOO level.
* Monitoring the leads status, and ensuring timely closer.
* Ensure all operational work of channel partners to be done smoothly at branch.


**Learning \& Innovation**
* Coach the branch staff on Gold loans products and support generating leads for that from existing customers.
* Resolve queries and escalations from the branch team related to Gold Loan in a well\-defined timeframe.
* Ensure adherence to training man\-days/ mandatory training programs for self.
* Ensure goal\-setting, midyear \-review and annual appraisal process happens within specified timelines for self.
